title: Design: An empty category row in QuickBooks settings shows the Not set hint
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin (a user with every setting, See Financial Data included).
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide at 100% zoom.
  • Use a location that is connected to QuickBooks Online, with every ShopView Accounts row mapped.
  • Have Internal Work Orders turned on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have one Internal category with no QuickBooks account (for example a new category).
  • Open the attached picture iwo-flow0-16-10-quickbooks-category-row-not-set.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The empty category row shows the empty-row hint "Not set. Parts cost of [category] work orders posts to the ShopView Review account until you pick one."

Words in square brackets in a message stand for the value they name, such as the work order's number or the customer's name exactly as it is saved; every other word of the message must match exactly.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11762 (Story 5, QuickBooks Online account mapping)

  • S5-R4: “While a category row is empty, the row shows the existing empty-row hint with the text "Not set. Parts cost of [category] work orders posts to the ShopView Review account until you pick one." There is no fallback from one row to another. While the setting is off, empty rows show no hint.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Internal Work Orders · All flows v6" (https://claude.ai/artifact/5jHR3nLeDinzks1viREFuo), version 1794484794-2031, read and rendered 12 Nov 2026: page "Flow 0 · Turn it on", board "10 QuickBooks · category row not set" (Flow 0 · Turn it on).
